discussion_comments.comment_body: Please remove the app URL reload from `refreshAccount`. The account/backend and environment are fixed for the app's lifetime, so resolve this configuration once at startup. A transport connection can retry the initial lookup if it failed, but after a successful lookup we don't need to reload it on every account refresh or reconnect. This also supersedes the earlier concern about clearing a stale URL after a runtime backend switch; that isn't a supported flow.

removed in [`728da6af`](https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/15043/commits/728da6afab). [`refreshAccount`](https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/15043/changes#diff-51d0e9d12c66cf07b9303f12d282288c397b2e396ae7f1c404a00cebf2b34c7bR127) only fetches the user now. the lookup has one call site, the transport subscription, and stops after the first answer, so a reconnect only retries a startup lookup that failed. covered by [`resolves the Cline app once and keeps it across refreshes and reconnects`](https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/15043/changes#diff-1ef61ec53cf8eed4470071337a35d29174dcd03a49149bbff67e27a84ab78539R209) and [`retries the Cline app lookup on reconnect until the sidecar answers`](https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/15043/changes#diff-1ef61ec53cf8eed4470071337a35d29174dcd03a49149bbff67e27a84ab78539R173).

Fixed in 0c51c9c: each path carries a read generation that is bumped when its cache entry is dropped (refresh, tab close, agent edit), and responses from a superseded generation are discarded. Added a test that holds a read open across a refresh and checks the stale response does not replace the fresh contents.

Fixed in d357de26d: a read that is already loading is left alone when a snapshot arrives; if the snapshot marked it stale, the response is kept and one follow-up read runs afterwards. Manual refresh now goes through the same path instead of clearing caches. Test holds a read across a 10s poll with fake timers and checks the late response lands and exactly one follow-up read is issued.
